themes.description: The app has numerous issues including crashing, unresponsiveness, confusing interface, and security concerns. Users report experiencing difficulties in navigating the app, transactions failing, and data being compromised or manipulated.
themes.business_impact: This theme indicates a significant erosion of customer trust, a loss of business due to high churn rates, and potential financial losses from transaction failures and data theft.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues may be a combination of subpar design, poor quality control, and inadequate testing, leading to a fragmented and unreliable user experience.
themes.action_plan:
• | Fix the app stability issues by addressing frequent crashes and slow performance
• Improve communication with users regarding app updates, transactions, and changes to their accounts
• Add clear and concise instructions for navigating the app
• Introduce a separate pin system for app access and tighten data security
• Enhance support for users, including AI assistance and clear ticket resolution processes

themes.description: Multiple users reported difficulties in redeeming cashback rewards, which were often rendered unusable for bill payments or recharge, citing opaque or misleading cashback systems.
themes.business_impact: Loss of customer trust, potential revenue decline due to reduced cashback redemptions, and increased churn risk as dissatisfied customers uninstall the app.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's cashback system may be too complex, misleading, or restrictive, causing user frustration and mistrust. This might be due to unclear or dynamic redemption rules, or an overly narrow scope of eligible transactions.
themes.action_plan: • Revamp the cashback system for clarity, transparency, and broader usability. Implement user-friendly redemption processes, provide clear communication on cashback eligibility and usage, and introduce flexible redemption options.

themes.description: Users are having trouble with creating and managing their accounts on the app. Common issues include failure to add funds, difficulties with linking bank accounts, and problems with account verification processes.
themes.business_impact: Delays and frustration with account management can lead to a decrease in user engagement and ultimately affect overall app adoption and customer retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues may be linked to problems in integrating and synchronizing with external banks and financial institutions, as well as potential shortcomings in the app's account management and verification processes.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a thorough review of external bank integrations to identify potential errors or incompatibilities
• Improve and streamline account management processes to reduce complexity and user friction
• Develop more comprehensive support resources and clear instructions for users to address common issues and concerns
